config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.title: Vanilla Outsider: Keep Gear
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.enable: Enable or disable the Keep Gear mod
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepAr: Keep equipped helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepWe: Keep swords, bows, crossbows, tridents, and maces on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepTo: Keep pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, shears, and fishing rods on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepCo: Keep storage containers (Shulker boxes, Bundles, Backpacks) on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.contai: If true, the empty container is kept but its contents spill on the ground
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepCo: Keep food, potions, and stews on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepRe: Keep raw materials, ores, and building blocks on death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.penalt: Apply durability wear to kept items on death
Percentage of max durability lost on death (Default: 10%)
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.enchan: Increase durability wear slightly for each enchantment level
Additional wear percentage added per total enchantment level
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.useEch: Consumes 1 Echo Shard in your inventory upon death to negate all durability wear
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.keepBi: If true, items with Curse of Binding stay equipped across death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.xpEnab: Keep a portion of experience upon death
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.xpPerc: Percentage of total XP kept across death (Default: 20%)
config.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.showMe: Displays a chat notification upon respawn indicating preserved gear
message.vanilla-outsider-keep-gear.echo_: §bEcho Shard resonance protected your gear from durability wear!
